notes.title: ⚗️New Hero: The Alchemist Joins the Game!
notes.content:
Magic isn't just about casting spells — sometimes, it's about mixing the right ingredients. Meet our newest hero: The Alchemist, a master of craft and transformation!

 What makes the Alchemist unique?

- Brews twice as many potions as any ordinary wizard.

- Crafted cards are always of a higher rank.

And with enough crafted cards in hand, they can even boost the rank of a card in the pyramid!

New enchantments like The Power of Crystals and Magnum Opus open up entirely new ways to approach crafting strategies. Will you unlock their full potential?

It’s time to play with crystals ✨

notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s been a busy week for our small team! We’ve received so much support and feedback! Today we've made some updates to our demo version:

[list]
[*][b] Added experimental support for a few more screen resolutions[/b],
[*] Added a few visual effects,
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[/list]
Thank you for helping us improve the game!

notes.title: Gameplay Tweaks: Smoother Start & Clearer Scoring!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to see so many of you playing our game and sharing your thoughts—thank you for your feedback! Thanks to your valuable comments, we've made some improvements:

- Reduced the difficulty of the first few levels
- Сombination "Same Strength" now gives bonus 20×2 points—hopefully, it's now clearer which moves are the most rewarding
- Tweaked some amulet bonuses for better balance

We’re constantly working to improve the player experience, and we hope you’ll give our game another try!
